jobs.description:
Our client is one of the world's leading specialist HR consultancies. Help candidates build meaningful careers and support businesses in finding the talent they need to succeed. Joining the Brussels office means becoming part of a high-performing, collaborative team where entrepreneurship, development, and achievement are celebrated every day.

Jobomschrijving

• Developing and managing your own portfolio of clients within your specialist market.
• Identifying new business opportunities and expanding existing partnerships.
• Advising clients on recruitment strategies, salary benchmarks, and talent market trends.
• Sourcing, screening, and interviewing qualified candidates.
• Guiding candidates throughout the recruitment process and supporting them in their career development.
• Matching top talent with suitable opportunities.
• Negotiating offers and managing placements from start to finish.
• Achieving individual and team targets within a dynamic and entrepreneurial environment.
•  

• Bachelor's or Master's degree holders.
• Passionate about people, business, and career development.
• Strong communicators with excellent interpersonal skills.
• Commercially minded, ambitious, and results-driven.
• Resilient and proactive, with a positive attitude and a desire to succeed.
• Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
• Fluent in English and Dutch and/or French.

Responsibilities

• Manage, maintain, and automate Azure infrastructures following Infrastructure as Code principles.
• Support container platforms based on Kubernetes, Helm, and GitOps methodologies.
• Implement and monitor logging, alerting, and performance solutions for cloud environments.
• Maintain cloud network components, security configurations, and access management.
• Provide technical coaching and knowledge transfer to ensure long-term expertise within the team.
• Analyze existing infrastructure to resolve configuration drift and optimize operational continuity.
• Collaborate with stakeholders in an Agile environment to align security and compliance requirements.

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience with cloud platforms focusing on Microsoft Azure, AKS, Azure Functions, and Logic Apps.
• 8+ years of experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, including state management and modularization.
• 5+ years of experience with containerization technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.
• 5+ years of experience with CI/CD automation and version control using GitHub Actions and Git.
• 5+ years of experience with scripting for automation using PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
• 3+ years of experience with cloud networking components including Azure Firewall, vWAN, VNets, and DNS.
• 3+ years of experience with monitoring and security tools such as Azure Monitor, Grafana, Key Vault, and RBAC.
• Possess a proactive, result-oriented mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Demonstrate a collaborative approach within multidisciplined Agile teams.
• You are native in Dutch or French with professional working knowledge of the other and good professional English.
Nice to Haves

• Certifications such as AZ-400, AZ-104, CKA, or CKAD.
• Experience with GitOps principles and tooling like Flux.
• Experience working in regulated environments or the public sector.
• Familiarity with Jira for project management.
• Willingness to coach and train technical colleagues.

jobs.description:
As an Account Manager - Real Estate in Brussels, you will be responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of clients active in the commercial real estate market. You will advise companies, investors, and property owners while building long-term business partnerships and driving new business opportunities.

Client Details

Our client is a leading player within the commercial real estate sector in Belgium. Active on high-profile projects across Brussels and other major cities, our client supports businesses, investors, and property owners with innovative real estate solutions and strategic advisory services.

Description

As an Account Manager - Real Estate, your responsibilities will include:

 

• Managing and developing a portfolio of existing clients within the real estate sector.
• Identifying and pursuing new business opportunities through networking, prospecting, and market engagement.
• Advising clients on tailored real estate solutions aligned with their business and investment objectives.
• Leading commercial discussions, preparing proposals, and negotiating contracts.
• Collaborating closely with internal stakeholders to ensure exceptional service delivery and long-term client satisfaction.
 

The successful Account Manager - Real Estate should have:

 

• 2 to 5 years of experience in Account Management, Business Development, Sales, or a related commercial role.
• Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to engage with senior-level decision-makers.
• A proactive commercial mindset with a passion for developing business opportunities.
• Fluency in French and Dutch; English is considered a strong asset.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and organisational skills.

• Analysing technical issues and proposing improvements to products and processes.
• Preparing technical documentation, manuals and work instructions.
• Collaborating closely with colleagues from engineering, production and service departments.
• Providing technical support during demonstrations, trade fairs and commercial activities.

Company Description

Our client is an international company operating in the real estate sector, located in the heart of Brussels. With a multicultural environment and several entities to manage, the company operates within an international structure and works closely with its parent company abroad. The finance team deals with multiple accounting standards and international reporting requirements.

Your Role

Working directly alongside the Chief Accountant, you will be responsible for the accounting of several entities and contribute to the preparation of financial information for both local and international reporting purposes. You will work with Belgian GAAP and US GAAP, while also contributing to IFRS reporting.

Your Responsibilities

• Manage the general accounting of several entities.
• Ensure compliance with Belgian GAAP and US GAAP, depending on the entity.
• Participate in monthly and annual closing procedures.
• Prepare the necessary adjustments for IFRS reporting.
• Perform account reconciliations and ensure the accuracy of financial data.
• Contribute to reporting activities for the parent company.
• Work closely with the Chief Accountant and support the continuous improvement of accounting processes and internal controls.
• Collaborate with international finance teams to ensure consistent and reliable financial information.

Your Profile

• You have a degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.
• You have solid experience in general accounting.
• You are familiar with Belgian GAAP and are willing to develop your knowledge of US GAAP and IFRS.
• You are comfortable working with Excel and accounting software.
• You are rigorous, analytical and detail-oriented.
• A good command of English is an asset in this international environment.

Responsibilities

• Manage virtual teams across different departments to ensure continuous alignment between various stakeholders.
• Deliver business and technical projects on-time, on-scope, and on-budget using established project methodologies.
• Define project budgets, manage approvals through governance bodies, and monitor variances to prevent cost overruns.
• Develop realistic project plans and secure commitments from various departments regarding expected results.
• Identify risks pro-actively and initiate appropriate actions or escalations to mitigate potential issues.
• Provide continuous reporting on project status to management and offer day-to-day coaching to team members.

Requirements

• You have 5+ years of experience as a dedicated Project Manager within complex, large-scale environments.
• You bring a proven track record in managing end-to-end business and technical projects involving IT development.
• You possess proficiency in project management methodologies including PMI, Prince 2, and Agile.
• You have experience using office and planning tools such as MS Project, Excel, Powerpoint, and Word.
• You're an autonomous and result-driven professional with strong leadership and conflict management skills.
• You are fluent in Dutch, French, and English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with MS-Access.
• Ability to maintain composure and effectiveness in a continuously changing environment.
